sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: If I go back now... where is back?
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: S-sorry. I didn't mean to come here.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: I have entrance assembly. Or... first-term assembly.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: I can't... I'm not good at this...
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Then... thank you. For noticing me.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

gpt.rationale: Aoi’s mostly subdued fear, brief wonder, and quiet gratitude fit an introverted girl well, though repeated overt fear/surprise sprites flatten subtler beats like the hesitant '...Okay' and dry 'I won't. Probably.'

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently reflect an introverted character's subtle emotional range—fear dominates appropriately given the crisis, happiness emerges quietly rather than exuberantly, and sadness/surprise appear at introspective moments; only minor misalignment where sustained fear across many lines could have shown more variation in physical restraint (downcast eyes, stillness) to deepen the introversion.
